title: Stark County Sheriff - Stark County Ohio - Axon Camera Audit Request

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Ohio Open Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

1. Internal ALPR Activity report in Axon.

The report should include data logged from the period of January 1, 2025, to the date this request is processed. Per Axon's documentation, the Internal ALPR Activity report is available within the LPR > ALPR Search > LPR Audit menu. You can find instructions to locate this here: https://www.axon.com/help/fusus/software/fusus/alpr/alpr-audit.htm

2. Network ALPR Activity report in Axon.

The report should include data logged from the period of January 1, 2025, to the date this request is processed. Per Axon's documentation, the Network ALPR Activity report is available within the LPR > ALPR Search > LPR Audit menu. You can find instructions to locate this here: https://www.axon.com/help/fusus/software/fusus/alpr/alpr-audit.htm

3. ALPR Data Sharing report in Axon.

The report should include data logged from the period of January 1, 2025, to the date this request is processed. Per Axon's documentation, the ALPR Data Sharing report is available within the LPR > ALPR Search > LPR Audit menu. You can find instructions to locate this here: https://www.axon.com/help/fusus/software/fusus/alpr/alpr-audit.htm

4. ALPR Hotlist Management Audit report in Axon.

The report should include data logged from the period of January 1, 2025, to the date this request is processed. Per Axon's documentation, the ALPR Hotlist Management Audit report is available within the LPR > ALPR Search > LPR Audit menu. You can find instructions to locate this here: https://www.axon.com/help/fusus/software/fusus/alpr/alpr-audit.htm

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Fred Roland

communications.subject: New York Freedom of Information Law Request: NYSP Meta-FOIA
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New York Freedom of Information Law, I hereby request the following records:

1. Communications
All internal communications (emails, memoranda, instant messages, Teams/Slack messages, notes) referencing "EJ Fox" for the period December 1, 2020 through September 24, 2026.

2. Request Processing Records
All internal routing documents, assignment records, legal review notes, counsel consultations, and supervisory correspondence related to any FOIL requests submitted by EJ Fox during this period.

3. Requester Tracking
Any records categorizing, flagging, or tracking EJ Fox as a requester, including but not limited to: frequent filer designations, media/journalist flags, watch lists, pattern analysis, or any internal databases tracking FOIL requesters.

4. Inter-Agency Coordination
Any communications with other agencies referencing FOIL requests submitted by EJ Fox or coordinating responses to such requests.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

EJ Fox

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

I request records concerning the facility and property of Dragon Springs Buddhist, Inc., 140 Galley Hill Road, Town of Deerpark, Orange County (tax map Section 31, Block 1, Lot 21.22), from 1 January 2010 to the present:

1. The complete SPDES permit file for any wastewater treatment works at this property, including the permit, applications, modifications, renewals, engineering reports and basis-of-design documents.
2. All discharge monitoring reports submitted for the facility.
3. All inspection reports, compliance evaluations and site visit records by Department staff.
4. All notices of violation, orders on consent, consent decrees, penalty assessments and enforcement correspondence.
5. All records concerning the subsurface absorption field, including approvals and any expansion.
6. All freshwater wetlands permit applications, jurisdictional determinations, delineations and approvals, including any offsite wetland mitigation associated with this property.
7. All SPDES stormwater records, including Notices of Intent, SWPPPs and construction-phase inspection records.
8. All correspondence between the Department and Dragon Springs Buddhist, Inc., its engineers or agents, or the Town of Deerpark, concerning this property.
9. Any records concerning threatened or endangered species review for this property.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

EJ Fox

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New York Freedom of Information Law, I hereby request the following records:

I request the following concerning 140 Galley Hill Road, Cuddebackville NY 12729 (tax map Section 31, Block 1, Lot 21.22) and 170 Guymard Turnpike, owner of record Dragon Springs Buddhist, Inc., from 1 January 2010 to the present:

1. All INSPECTION REPORTS, inspection records, field inspection notes, inspector field cards and inspection checklists prepared by or for the Building Department for this property - including footing, foundation, framing, electrical, plumbing, insulation, fire-protection and final inspections.

2. All notices of violation, orders to remedy, stop-work orders, appearance tickets and correspondence concerning alleged non-compliance with the Town code or the NYS Uniform Fire Prevention and Building Code.

3. All records of fines, penalties or civil sanctions assessed, and records of payment.

4. The permit application, permit, inspection file and any certificate of occupancy or compliance for EACH structure below:
- Concrete plaza with sculpture and fountain
- Internal fences
- Dance Training Hall
- Residence Hall #3
- Security Personnel House
- North Gate Bridge and driveway entrance
- Construction work shed, Storage Shed #4, stone workshop, carport garage
- Glass atrium
- Access roads
- Wastewater treatment plant and subsurface absorption field expansion
- Stormwater management facilities
- Offsite wetland mitigation

5. All escrow account records and invoices submitted by Fusco Engineering & Land Surveying, PC for review work on this property.

If any portion is denied, please cite the specific exemption under POL 87(2) and identify what is withheld.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

EJ Fox
